page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.re8.180xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 720 dedicated vCPUs utilizing Intel Xeon 8490H processors running at a base clock speed of 1.9 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The instance is equipped with 12288.0 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of approximately 17.07 GB per core.

This instance does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying entirely on network-attached storage solutions. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 192 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput data transfers. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.re8.180xlarge offers extreme resource density, consolidating massive memory and compute capacities into a single virtual machine to reduce the overhead associated with managing large-scale distributed clusters.

The massive memory footprint and high core count make this instance suitable for large-scale in-memory databases, enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems, massive data caching layers, and complex real-time data analytics. It is also designed for heavy enterprise workloads requiring substantial memory capacity without the need for local NVMe storage or hardware GPU acceleration.
